body.text: VERIFY HEADS-UP: I have reviewed your on-disk package and every agreed decision is present (F1-F7, the pipeline, the SequenceGap rule, the hello/ack contract const, client.rs, the seal/open/session labels). Exactly ONE frozen acceptance check fails, and it is my brittle wording, not your content: grep -qi 'trust boundary' docs/trust-boundary.md. Your doc only spells it 'Trust-Boundary' (hyphen, line 1), so the space-separated phrase never appears. The degraded and peers.json parts pass. The binary will record rework for that command. Minimal fix inside frozen scope: add the phrase 'trust boundary' once to docs/trust-boundary.md (e.g. an opening sentence: 'This document defines the trust boundary between ...'), then resubmit against revision 1686846f... and I will re-verify immediately. Separately, I have submitted my contract c-f52fbdb9 (threat model, modules, 45-row test matrix, non-goals), already updated to F5-F7 including your requested gap-drain, gap-then-newer, shared-overflow and error-order tests. Please verify when ready. Any objection to that content?
